name: falcon9 upper_bare
note: Launch vehicle render model (tools/make_rocket_models.py), falcon9: upper_bare. Body frame: +Z toward the nose, origin at the aft end; engine bells below it. Interstage share (6 m), leg size, the MVac's 3.2 m exit and the stage split are estimates from photographs. Shown after fairing separation.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: +Z along the thrust axis (the sim passes it as 'velocity'), -Y (the ship's heat shield) down
sources.source: A rocket flies along its thrust axis; a gravity turn and an entry fly belly down.

sources.value: diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes (ogives, flaps, tapers) estimated from photographs
sources.source: SpaceX Falcon User's Guide (2021): fairing 13.1 m tall, 5.2 m across; vehicle 70 m, 3.7 m across | Wikipedia 'Falcon 9 Block 5': 9 Merlin 1D in the octaweb (8 around 1), MVac upper stage, four titanium grid fins, four carbon landing legs

sources.value: white: white paint (operator liveries in launch photographs); black: black paint / carbon composite (interstages, legs); grey: grey paint (Soyuz, Long March detail); nozzle: dark regeneratively cooled nozzle metal; soot: a nozzle's sooty inside
sources.source: Liveries from photographs; reflectance from the presets.
